items.name: Little Horror: flush crystal barnacles, skyglass-cyan eyes

data.description: The Core tried to remember the ship's mascot and rebuilt it from the wreck's rot: a round, tar-slick thing dripping slime, crusted with clouded crystal, its grin far too wide and far too full of teeth. It has decided you are its crew.
data.artDirection: Hairless, no fur or tufts: a round-bodied, frog-like rot creature with a plump torso, a big round head and four short stubby legs with soft paw pads, and a short tapering tail. Its hide is glossy and tar-slick, streaked with thick dripping slime in the palette's accent colour. Clouded crystal is crusted into its hide in small irregular barnacle clusters, sitting flush, never standing up as spikes, posts or a row. Its eyes are always pale skyglass cyan with a bright pinpoint highlight, whatever the palette. Its signature: an enormous grin that splits its face nearly ear to ear, packed with jagged white teeth. Creepy-cute, mischievous, a little unsettling.
rankConcepts: A round, tar-slick rot creature on stubby legs with a huge toothy grin and pale cyan eyes, slime dripping off it, a few flush crystal barnacles on its back
A little longer in the legs and steadier on its feet; the crystal barnacles spread in an uneven patch over its back
Full adult size, still round-bodied; the grin reaches nearly ear to ear and the slime streaks run thicker
Its teeth turn jagged and crystal-tipped and its paw claws darken; the grin is now plainly a weapon
The barnacle patch fuses into one smooth crystal plate lying flat across its back and shoulders
Slime streaks settle into bold painted patterns across its hide in the palette's accent colour
The slime patterns glow faintly in its aura colour and the crystal plate lights from within
A collar of tarred rigging rope with a small crystal medallion, worn alongside any collar, scarf or charm it already has
Sitting up proud with one paw raised, head high, the crystal plate polished clear, grin wide
The wreck's guardian: glossy and commanding, its crystal plate catching the light, the same enormous grin and cyan eyes
